description.value: Joyeaux Café & Restaurant is a long-running casual eatery in downtown Vancouver serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner from a menu blending Western dishes with Asian and Vietnamese cooking, including Vietnamese noodle soups, all rooted in owner Annie's home-cook recipes. Located on Howe Street in the city core, it offers dine-in and take-out as well as delivery, making it a convenient food stop for cyclists moving through the downtown grid.
